title: customers.customer-merged.v1
description: Two customer records were judged to be the same person and one of them survived. This is the event other modules must act on: a customer identifier a consumer holds may now name a record that no longer stands, and the consumer re-points its own references to aggregateId. docs/architecture/invariants.md INV-CUS-04 draws the line — references are re-pointed, snapshots frozen onto an invoice, job card or notification are never rewritten. There is no un-merge, and there is no corresponding customer-unmerged event.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it. It is also stored on the merge record, so the decision and the message about it can be matched from either end.

occurredAt.description: When the merge was recorded, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The customer that survived, and answers for the person from now on. The aggregate is the survivor rather than the record that went away, because per-aggregate ordering is only worth having against the record that has further events to come.

organisationId.description: The organisation both records belong to. A merge never crosses one.

mergedCustomerId.description: The customer that was folded in. A reference a consumer holds to this identifier should now name aggregateId instead — except where it is part of a snapshot already frozen onto settled work.

mergeId.description: The merge decision, so a consumer asking on whose authority has something to quote back. Who decided, when and why stays in Customers.

branchId.description: The branch the decision was taken at, or null where the session was working in none.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
